description.value: The Powell River Town Centre Hotel bills itself as Powell River's only full-service hotel, with 71 air-conditioned guest rooms and suites ranging from standard courtyard-view rooms to executive suites with Jacuzzi tubs. Centrally located in the city hub on BC's Sunshine Coast, it sits near shopping, transit, and recreation areas. On-site amenities include a licensed restaurant, a pub serving dinner, and banquet facilities for up to 300 guests.

address.value: 4660 Joyce Avenue, Powell River, BC V8A 3B6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and fully accessible, confirming the hotel's address, phone, and key amenities. WiFi is confirmed multiple times ('FREE WiFi', 'Complimentary high-speed wireless internet access'). On-site dining including TC's Pub (which serves dinner) is confirmed. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere on the site; both required criteria remain null. The OSM toll-free number matches the website's toll-free reservation line exactly.
concerns: OSM lists only the toll-free number (+1-866-485-3001); website also prominently lists a local main line (604.485.3000) that is not in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service hotel in a cycling-relevant destination, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website. Needs direct outreach to confirm whether cycling guests can be accommodated before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website notes an on-site Electric Vehicle charging station for guest use; this does not confirm e-bike charging capability and was not counted as such.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site TC's Pub explicitly described as 'serving dinner'; Garden Court Restaurant also on-site

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: 71-room full-service hotel, Powell River town centre; $140-190
